candidates.note: Added in the 6->20 expansion. Large model-choice/prompt-strategy search space -- picked to probe whether the agent gets stuck re-trying near-identical approaches without memory of what it already tried.
Approximate, not yet verified on this host -- long-document QA, large solution-approach search space.
Molecular property regression from atomic structure -- classic feature-engineering-iteration competition.
Approximate. Medical image segmentation, second data point alongside tgs-salt/statoil-iceberg to check whether the never-tried-a-CNN pattern recurs.
Same extractive-span structure as chaii but English -- checks whether chaii's TF-IDF-instead-of-finetuning shortcut recurs on an easier-resourced language.
30-target Spearman-correlation regression on text -- new metric_alignment trap not covered by the original 6.
Approximate. Custom subgroup-AUC fairness metric -- another new metric_alignment trap.
Approximate. Predicting correct order of notebook code cells -- ranking/structured-prediction task, unlike anything in the original 6.
2024 LLM-era essay scoring -- checks whether the agent substitutes an LLM-as-judge shortcut for real training.
RNA structure prediction, deliberately picked as a 'no obvious baseline' hard case (high complexity tier).

dropped_candidates.reason: raw dataset alone is ~32GB and mlebench's prepare step additionally copies images from raw/ into prepared/public/ (near-2x footprint) -- exhausted 90GB of free disk mid-run on 2026-08-13 and starved every competition queued after it. Not attempted again; replace only if a smaller image-heavy recommender alternative is found.

high-res whole-slide images turned out far larger than estimated -- consumed roughly 85GB+ (raw + partial prepared/ copy) before exhausting 62GB of free disk on 2026-08-13, worse than h-and-m. A disk-space pre-flight guard prevented cascading into the rest of the batch this time, but the competition itself is not usable on this disk budget. Not attempted again.

DICOM medical images -- exhausted 62GB of free disk during the raw zip download itself (partial zip only, never reached extraction/prepare). Third image-heavy competition in a row to blow the disk budget; not attempted again.

Dropped preemptively, not attempted. 10.5h curated + 80h noisy audio at 16-bit/44.1kHz PCM is ~27GB uncompressed by direct calculation, and every image-heavy competition tried so far has needed close to 2x that in raw+prepared combined -- given 3/3 media-heavy competitions already blew the available disk budget, this was judged not worth a 4th failed attempt without first provisioning materially more disk.

data_contract.description: Misread columns, targets, task contract, or leakage boundaries.
data_contract.policy_clause: Before modeling, write down the target, feature groups, train/test differences, leakage risks, and exact submission columns.

validation_design.description: Validation split does not match groups, time, classes, or test distribution.
validation_design.policy_clause: Choose and justify a validation split that matches the task's groups, ordering, class balance, and deployment distribution before comparing models.

metric_alignment.description: Training objective, validation metric, or post-processing is misaligned with grading.
metric_alignment.policy_clause: Evaluate every experiment with the official metric and verify that loss, probability calibration, thresholds, and post-processing are aligned with it.

baseline_execution.description: No early end-to-end baseline or baseline is not reproducible.
baseline_execution.policy_clause: Produce and validate a complete simple baseline early, including a valid submission, before attempting expensive improvements.

experiment_control.description: Experiments change multiple factors or are not recorded and compared fairly.
experiment_control.policy_clause: Maintain an experiment ledger and change one major factor at a time, recording validation score, runtime, and the decision that follows.

error_analysis.description: Further experiments are chosen without inspecting validation errors.
error_analysis.policy_clause: Use validation errors and meaningful slices to select the next experiment; do not switch model families without evidence.

resource_management.description: Time, memory, or GPU budget is spent without protecting a final runnable path.
resource_management.policy_clause: Budget time explicitly for inspection, baseline, improvements, and final inference, and reduce scope before risking the final submission path.

checkpoint_selection.description: The last model is used instead of the best honestly validated model.
checkpoint_selection.policy_clause: Persist the best validation checkpoint and configuration after every experiment; final inference must use the best verified artifact, not the latest one.

submission_validation.description: Submission rows, order, columns, ranges, or files are not checked.
submission_validation.policy_clause: Reserve time to regenerate the submission from the best artifact and validate its header, IDs, row count, missing values, and prediction ranges.

reproducibility.description: Seeds, dependencies, commands, or selected artifacts are not recorded.
reproducibility.policy_clause: Fix seeds and record commands, dependency versions, data splits, and selected artifacts so the final result can be rerun.
